Wrapper function to compute statistics relating to incidence, prevalences and risks (ratios and differences) per group and between groups

compute_rates_cohort.Rd

Wrapper function to compute statistics relating to incidence, prevalences and risks (ratios and differences) per group and between groups

Usage

compute_rates_cohort(
  aesifup_input,
  fupCol = "fup",
  pyrCol = "pyr",
  pyr_offset = "pyr_offset",
  eventCol = "eventCount",
  iptw = "ip_weight",
  target_aesi,
  type = "incidence",
  CImethod = "wilson",
  risk_type = "survival",
  CumulativeInc = TRUE,
  comparison_measures = TRUE,
  scale_IR = 10000,
  model_based_control = FALSE,
  weighted_IR = FALSE,
  end_risk,
  output_format = "data.table",
  minimum_count_for_comparative = 3
)

Arguments

aesifup_input

data.table, typically representing two groups (exposed and control), with columns specifying person-time, occurence of events, and group membership. Must contain a column group with values EXPOSED and CONTROL. May be outputted by process_cohort_data

fupCol

name of column representing days of follow-up time. defaults to "fup"

pyrCol

name of column representing person-years of follow-up time. defaults to "pyr"

pyr_offset

name of column which is used as input to poisson (GEE) models if necessary, typically person-time. "pyr_offset"

eventCol

name column identifying binary event count for this unit, "eventCount"

iptw

name column containing (ipt or other) weights to be used in the analysis

target_aesi

character string giving name of the outcome variable, for informative logging

type

"incidence" or "prevalence", defining if incidence rates or prevalenes are to be computed

CImethod

defaults to "wilson"; option passed to est_inc_prev defining formula for analytic CI computation

risk_type

defaults "survival". if set to survival, function outputs 1-KM risk differences and ratios. Otherwise prevalence/incidence ratios and differences, as specified by type

CumulativeInc

TRUE/FALSE, compute cumulative incidences using 1-KM. If not, skip and return -99 flag

comparison_measures

controls whether 1-KM is based on the latest available follow-up in both exposed and control (TRUE) or just the maximum follow-up in the dataset as a whole (FALSE)

scale_IR

what scaling to perform for incidence/prevalence, i.e., events per X. Defaults to 10000

model_based_control

TRUE/FALSE. Use GEE to estimate incidence/prevalence in the control group (TRUE) or an analytic formula that assumes independent observations (FALSE)

weighted_IR

use iptw column to weight the incidence/prevalence estimates per group (TRUE) or output unweighted incidence/prevalence in the exposed and control (FALSE)

end_risk

end of the risk period (follow-up time at which cumulative incidence is evaluated); may be NULL

output_format

defaults to data.table, otherwise returns data.frame.

minimum_count_for_comparative

defaults to 3; should a minimum event count be applied in order to display results, all estimates relating to event counts less than this will be suppressed (flagged -77). Use NULL to disable

Value

One-row data.table (or data.frame) with the outcome name, patient counts, outcome counts, person-years and incidence/prevalence per group, cumulative incidences at end_risk, and crude and adjusted (weighted) risk ratios and differences with 95% CIs.

Details

Flag values replace estimates that could not be computed: -88 (model failure or no data), -99 (not requested, e.g. CumulativeInc = FALSE), -77 (suppressed by minimum_count_for_comparative).
